title: Metacognitive Therapy Versus Cognitive Behavioral Therapy: A Network Approach
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Limited sample size; - No formal statistical tests for comparing network structures between treatments; - Items from BAI may not be representative of catastrophic beliefs; - No validation dataset for replication; - No packages for estimating stability and accuracy in longitudinal networks.
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain them. The authors note that no validation dataset was available at the time of writing.
